agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/others.py: StripWhitespaceFilter._stripws_default had an inverted condition causing normal single whitespace tokens between non-whitespace tokens to be erased (e.g. 'select (select 2)' -> 'select(select2)'). Corrected the logic so a whitespace token collapses to '' only when it immediately follows another whitespace token (de-duplicating consecutive whitespace), and otherwise normalizes to a single space. Verified via multiple manual sqlparse.format() checks (strip_whitespace, strip_comments, reindent, strip_whitespace=False, parenthesis cases) that behavior now matches expectations.
